newsitem.title: USA: DTE, Mechanical Tech in venture.
newsitem.headline: DTE, Mechanical Tech in venture.

text.p: Edison Development Corp and Mechanical Technology Inc said Thursday they signed a letter of intent to form Plug Power LLC, a joint venture to develop and manufacture fuel cells.
A final agreement is expected by late June. Edison Development is a unit of DTE Energy Co. Latham, N.Y.-based Mechanical Technology makes measurement and test systems.
Plug Power plans to develop a proton exchange membrane, or PEM, fuel cell system that converts natural gas to electricity without combustion.

The fuel cell could be installed inside or outside the home and should be capable of serving an entire household's energy needs, the companies said. Residential market trials are expected to start in about three years.
The joint venture plans to seek additional partners such as chemical companies and high-tech firms to increase investment in research and development.
